reference.scoringTableSanma: Scoring table in three-player is the same as four-player unless north bisection is used. In that case, points that would have been lost from the north player is redistributed.

afterKanFu.help: Whether to count the 2 fu granted by tsumo if the hand won with after a kan.

allGreensDragon.help: Whether to require the green dragon to count the all green yaku.

brightTiles.help: 深色主题下使用浅色麻将牌图案。

countedYakuman.help: Whether to count a hand worth at least 13 han as Yakuman or as Sanbaiman.

doubleWindFu.help: Whether to count a wind pair that is both the round wind and the seat wind as 4 fu or 2 fu.

doubleYakuman.help:
Whether to count certain special yaku as being worth a Double Yakuman.
These include:

gameMode.help:
The number of players in the game.
Three-player mahjong uses the sanma rules, which includes no chii, no 2 to 8 of characters, and kita.

northTiles.help: North tiles can either be called with kita or used as yakuhai regardless of wind in three-player mahjong. With kita, a counter will be added to count north tiles.

noYakuDora.help: Whether to calculate dora even when with no yaku.

noYakuFu.help: Whether to calculate fu even when with no yaku. Hands will have <H>0</H> han.

openAllSimples.help: Whether to allow the all simples yaku to be counted if the hand has open sets.

otherScoring.help:
Whether to show counters to add in extra yaku han, dora, and yakuman.
These can be used for purposes such as extra red fives, other dora, and unsupported local yaku.

paoPayment.help:
Whether to show the ability to distribute points using pao.
This is used when a player aids in the creation of a Yakuman.
With tsumo, the responsible player will pay full amount.
With ron, the responsible player and the player who dealt in will each pay half.

redFives.help: The number of red fives available in the calculator when building a hand.

roundedMangan.help:
Whether to round up hands worth 4 han 30 fu or 3 han 60 fu to a Mangan.
Otherwise, they are worth the usual 2000/3900 and 7700 (non-dealer) or 3900 and 11600 (dealer).

showTileNames.help: 是否在牌面角落显示简称。

theme.help: 切换浅色或深色主题；再次点击可恢复跟随系统。

toggleYaku.help:
Toggle the yaku available in the calculator.
Optional yaku are some of the usual yaku, enabled by default. They may be disabled if needed.
Local yaku are generally less common and are disabled by default.

tsumoPoints.help:
The distribution of points when a player wins with tsumo.
If Loss is enabled the base points are the same as in four player. In effect, the winning player loses the points from the missing north player. If Bisection is enabled, the base points will include the points from the north player that should have been paid. In effect, the other two players will pay more.

yakumanStacking.help:
Whether to allow stacking multiple Yakuman together or cap the max at a single Yakuman.
Double Yakuman are also disabled if this is disabled.

benikujaku.help: A hand composed using only red bamboo tiles (1, 5, 7, 9) and/or the red dragon.

chankan.help: Win off a player upgrading a pon into a kan.

chiihou.help: Call tsumo on your first as a non-dealer. Calls invalidate.

chiitoitsu.help: A hand consisting of seven pairs. An exception to the usual hand composition of four sets and a pair.

chiniisou.help: A hand composed out of only one suit.

chinroutou.help: A hand composed entirely out of terminal tiles.

chuurenpoutou.help: A hand consisting of the tiles 1112345678999 in the same suit plus an extra tile of the same suit.

daichiishin.help: A Seven Pairs hand consisting of all seven of the honor tiles. Does not combine with all honors.

daichikurin.help: A Seven Pairs hand consisting of 2 to 8 of bamboo.

daisharin.help: A Seven Pairs hand consisting of 2 to 8 of circles.

daisuurin.help: A Seven Pairs hand consisting of 2 to 8 of characters.

doubleriichi.help: Declare riichi with a 1000 point bet when in tenpai on your first turn. Calls invalidate. Can no longer change your hand; draws are discarded unless they are a win.

haiteiraoyue.help: Win on the final draw from the wall.

honchantaiyaochuu.help: All tile sets in the hand contains a terminal or an honor.

honiisou.help: A hand composed out of only one suit and honors.

honroutou.help: A hand composed entirely out of terminal and honor tiles.

houteiraoyui.help: Win on the final discard from the wall.

hyakumangoku.help: A full flush hand of characters, such that the numeric values sum up to at least 100.

iipeikou.help: A hand with two identical sequences.

ikkitsuukan.help: The sequences 123, 456, 789 in a single suit.

ippatsu.help: Additional <H>1</H> han if you win before your next discard after calling riichi. Calls invalidate.

isshokusanjun.help: A hand containing three identical sequences in the same suit.

junchantaiyaochuu.help: All tile sets in the hand contains a terminal.

junseichuurenpoutou.help: With nine gates, win with a nine-sided wait. That is, your tenpai hand is exactly 1112345678999.

kokuiisou.help: A hand composed using only black circles tiles (2, 4, 8) and/or the wind tiles.

kokushimusou.help: A hand with each of the thirteen different terminal and honor tiles plus an extra terminal or honor. In some rule variations, ron may be allowed on a closed kan of the winning tile.

kokushimusoujuusanmenmachi.help: With thirteen orphans, win with a thirteen-sided wait. That is, your tenpai hand already has one of each terminal and honor.

menzenchintsumohou.help: Win with tsumo with a closed hand.

dora.help:
A dora indicator is flipped at the start of each hand, pointing to the dora. Another dora indicator is flipped per kan. Uradora indicators underneath are revealed on a riichi win.
Red fives are also dora. Each dora in hand counts as 1 han.
Winds go East → South → West → North → East.
Dragons go White → Green → Red → White.

kazehai.help: The round wind and/or the seat wind. Gain <H>1</H> han for each set. Gain <H>2</H> han if wind is both round and seat wind.

kita.help: In three-player mahjong, north tiles that were called counts as dora. In certain rule variations, north instead counts as yakuhai for every player.

nagashimangan.help: At an exhaustive draw, a <H>Mangan</H> is awarded if your discards are only terminals and honors and none were called by other players. This may be scored as a <H>Mangan</H>, <H>5</H> han, etc. depending on rule variations.

sangenpai.help: Any of the three dragons. Gain <H>1</H> han for each set.

pinfu.help: A hand worth <H>0</H> fu based on its composition. That is, it contains only sequences, a non-yakuhai pair (not a dragon or round/seat wind), and a two-sided open wait.

renhou.help: Call ron before your first turn. Calls invalidate.

riichi.help: Declare riichi with a 1000 point bet when in tenpai (one away from winning). Can no longer change your hand; draws are discarded unless they are a win.

rinshankaihou.help: Win on the dead wall draw after calling kan. In three-player mahjong, a win on the dead wall draw after calling kita also counts.

ryanpeikou.help: Two separate instances of two identical sequences. Does not combine with seven pairs.

ryuuiisou.help: A hand composed using only green bamboo tiles (2, 3, 4, 6, 8) and/or the green dragon. Green dragon may be required in certain rule variations.

sanankou.help: Three concealed triplets (not called with pon, open kan, or ron). Other sets may be open.

sanrenkou.help: A hand containing three triplets in the same suit where their number steps by one.

sanshokudoujun.help: The same sequence in each suit.

sanshokudoukou.help: A hand containing the same triplet in each suit.

shiiaruraotai.help: A hand with four open sets (i.e. not including closed kan) waiting for a single tile to complete. Can win on tsumo or ron.

shousangen.help: Two sets and a pair of each dragon. The <H>2</H> han from having two dragon triplets are still included.

shousuushii.help: Three sets and a pair of each wind.

suuankou.help: Four concealed triplets (not called with pon, open kan, or ron).

suuankoutankimachi.help: With four concealed triplets, win with a single-tile wait (making a pair, allowing ron).

tanyaochuu.help: A hand composed of only tiles 2 through 8. This yaku may be closed only in certain rule variations.

tenhou.help: Call tsumo on your first turn as the dealer. Calls invalidate.

toitoihou.help: A hand consisting of only triplets.

tsuuiisou.help: A hand composed entirely out of honor tiles.

uumensai.help: A hand containing all five different suits (characters, circles, bamboo, winds, and dragons).
